description:
Cast Abuelo's Awakening by paying {3}{W}, targeting Phyrexian Metamorph.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Abuelo's Awakening, targeting Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the copy of Abuelo's Awakening, returning Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Naru Meha.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Phyrexian Metamorph's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, copying Abuelo's Awakening, targeting Phyrexian Metamorph.
Repeat from step 4.
